scope: turning (right turns, left turns and U-turns, at intersections and elsewhere)

vocabulary.definition: A person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle.
The area within the prolongation of the lateral curb lines, or the lateral boundary lines of the roadways, of two highways that join one another at approximately right angles or any other angle.
The portion of a highway improved, designed, or ordinarily used for vehicular travel.

The portion of a roadway at an intersection that is an extension of the sidewalk or curb lines, whether marked or not, or any portion of a roadway marked for pedestrian crossing by lines or other markings.
A person on foot, or a person using a means of conveyance propelled by human power other than a bicycle, or a person using a motorized wheelchair or similar device because of a disability.
A person riding a bicycle.
A lane of a roadway marked and signed for the preferential use of bicycles.
A solid white line, not less than 12 inches wide, marking the point where a vehicle must stop in obedience to a stop sign or signal.
A turn made to reverse the direction of travel on the same highway.
A lane near the center of a highway, marked on each side by an inner broken yellow line and an outer solid yellow line, set aside for left turns or U-turns by traffic moving in either direction.
A highway divided into two or more roadways by an intermediate space, physical barrier, or a section clearly indicated by two sets of double yellow lines, each set at least two feet apart.

An area where 50 percent or more of the frontage along a highway for a distance of 300 feet or more is occupied by buildings in use for business; the handbook also treats areas with churches, apartments, multiple dwelling houses and public buildings (except schools) as business districts.

The portion of a highway and the property contiguous to it, other than a business district, upon one side of which within a quarter of a mile the contiguous property fronting thereon is occupied by 13 or more separate dwelling houses or business structures, or upon both sides of which collectively within a quarter mile there are 16 or more such houses or structures.
Any sign, signal, marking, or device placed or erected by authority of a public body or official having jurisdiction to regulate, warn, or guide traffic.
A steady green arrow signal indication.
A steady yellow arrow signal indication, warning that the protected turning period is ending.
A flashing yellow arrow signal indication permitting a turn in the direction of the arrow after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
A steady red arrow signal indication.
A highway on which vehicular traffic is permitted to travel in one direction only.
A circular intersection where traffic travels counterclockwise around a center island.

rules.title: Turn only with reasonable safety
rules.when: intending to turn a vehicle from a direct course or move right or left upon a ROADWAY
rules.action: make the movement
rules.unless: it can be made with reasonable safety
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn a vehicle from a direct course or move right or left upon a ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the movement, UNLESS it can be made with reasonable safety.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap, distance or speed criterion given

rules.title: Signal when others may be affected
rules.when: turning right or left or moving right or left upon a ROADWAY AND any other vehicle may be affected by the movement
rules.action: give an appropriate signal before making the movement
rules.statement: WHEN turning right or left or moving right or left upon a ROADWAY AND any other vehicle may be affected by the movement, the DRIVER MUST give an appropriate signal before making the movement.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say which vehicles count as affected

rules.note: CVC 22107. The handbook advises signalling even when no one is seen.

rules.title: Signal during last 100 feet
rules.when: a signal of intention to turn right or left is required
rules.action: give the signal continuously during the last 100 feet traveled before turning
rules.statement: WHEN a signal of intention to turn right or left is required, the DRIVER MUST give the signal continuously during the last 100 feet traveled before turning.

rules.title: Hand signal for left turn
rules.when: signalling a left turn by hand and arm
rules.action: extend the hand and arm beyond the left side of the vehicle horizontally
rules.statement: WHEN signalling a left turn by hand and arm, the DRIVER MUST extend the hand and arm beyond the left side of the vehicle horizontally.

rules.title: Hand signal for right turn
rules.when: signalling a right turn by hand and arm
rules.action: extend the left hand and arm upward beyond the left side of the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN signalling a right turn by hand and arm, the DRIVER MUST extend the left hand and arm upward beyond the left side of the vehicle.
rules.note: CVC 22111. Bicyclists may alternatively extend the right arm horizontally to the right; this alternative is not stated for motor vehicle drivers.

rules.title: Look over shoulder before turning
rules.when: about to make a right or left turn
rules.action: look over the shoulder on the side of the turn for vehicles, motorcycles, CYCLISTS and PEDESTRIANS
rules.statement: WHEN about to make a right or left turn, the DRIVER MUST look over the shoulder on the side of the turn for vehicles, motorcycles, CYCLISTS and PEDESTRIANS.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook turning steps.

rules.title: Slow or stop before turning
rules.when: approaching the point of a right or left turn
rules.action: slow down, or stop if necessary, before turning
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the point of a right or left turn, the DRIVER MUST slow down, or stop if necessary, before turning.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when a stop is needed

rules.note: California Driver Handbook turning steps.

rules.title: Obey turn-control devices
rules.when: OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES are placed requiring and directing that a turn be made in a specific manner
rules.action: make the turn only as directed by the devices
rules.statement: WHEN OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES are placed requiring and directing that a turn be made in a specific manner, the DRIVER MUST make the turn only as directed by the devices.

rules.title: No-turn signs
rules.when: a sign prohibiting a right turn, a left turn or a U-TURN is posted at a location
rules.action: make the prohibited turn at that location
rules.statement: WHEN a sign prohibiting a right turn, a left turn or a U-TURN is posted at a location, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the prohibited turn at that location.
rules.note: CVC 22101 and 21461; some no-turn signs apply only at posted times.

rules.title: Entering highway from driveway or alley
rules.when: about to enter or cross a highway from any public or private property or from an alley
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to all traffic approaching on the highway close enough to constitute an immediate hazard, and continue to yield until it is reasonably safe to proceed
rules.statement: WHEN about to enter or cross a highway from any public or private property or from an alley, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to all traffic approaching on the highway close enough to constitute an immediate hazard, and continue to yield until it is reasonably safe to proceed.

vague_terms.term: close enough to constitute an immediate hazard
vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time gap given

rules.title: Yield to pedestrians on sidewalk when turning into or out of driveway
rules.when: turning into or out of a driveway, alley or private road AND crossing a sidewalk
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to any PEDESTRIAN approaching on the sidewalk
rules.statement: WHEN turning into or out of a driveway, alley or private road AND crossing a sidewalk, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to any PEDESTRIAN approaching on the sidewalk.

rules.title: Right turn close to right curb
rules.when: making a right turn
rules.action: make both the approach for the turn and the turn as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST make both the approach for the turn and the turn as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance from the curb given

rules.title: Finish right turn in right lane
rules.when: completing a right turn
rules.action: end the turn in the right lane of the road entered without swinging wide into another lane of traffic
rules.statement: WHEN completing a right turn, the DRIVER MUST end the turn in the right lane of the road entered without swinging wide into another lane of traffic.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook. Large trucks and buses may need to swing wide; see TURN-USER-04.

rules.title: Enter bicycle lane before right turn
rules.when: it is necessary to cross a BICYCLE LANE adjacent to the DRIVER's lane to make a turn
rules.action: drive into the BICYCLE LANE before making the turn, no more than 200 feet from the INTERSECTION or place of the turn
rules.statement: WHEN it is necessary to cross a BICYCLE LANE adjacent to the DRIVER's lane to make a turn, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST drive into the BICYCLE LANE before making the turn, no more than 200 feet from the INTERSECTION or place of the turn.
rules.note: CVC 21717 and 21209. Where the bicycle lane line is solid rather than dashed, local markings may differ.

rules.title: Check bicycle lane before merging
rules.when: about to merge into a BICYCLE LANE to make a right turn
rules.action: look over the right shoulder for CYCLISTS and merge only when no CYCLIST is in the way
rules.statement: WHEN about to merge into a BICYCLE LANE to make a right turn, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST look over the right shoulder for CYCLISTS and merge only when no CYCLIST is in the way.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook; CVC 21209 also requires the merge to be made safely.

rules.title: Right turn on red after stop
rules.when: facing a steady circular red signal AND the DRIVER has stopped at the LIMIT LINE, or before the CROSSWALK if there is no LIMIT LINE, or before the INTERSECTION if there is neither
rules.action: turn right after yielding to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN facing a steady circular red signal AND the DRIVER has stopped at the LIMIT LINE, or before the CROSSWALK if there is no LIMIT LINE, or before the INTERSECTION if there is neither, the DRIVER MAY turn right after yielding to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.
rules.note: CVC 21453(b). Failure to stop fully before a right turn on red is a red-light violation (base fine reported lower than for running a red light); penalty amount not stated here.

rules.title: No turn on red arrow
rules.when: facing a steady RED ARROW
rules.action: enter the INTERSECTION to make the movement indicated by the arrow
rules.unless: a signal permitting that movement is shown
rules.statement: WHEN facing a steady RED ARROW, the DRIVER MUST NOT enter the INTERSECTION to make the movement indicated by the arrow, UNLESS a signal permitting that movement is shown.
rules.note: CVC 21453(c). In California a right turn on a red arrow is not allowed even after stopping.

rules.title: Left turn from extreme left lane
rules.when: making a left turn
rules.action: make the approach as close as practicable to the left-hand edge of the extreme left-hand lane or portion of the ROADWAY lawfully available to traffic moving in the DRIVER's direction
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn, the DRIVER MUST make the approach as close as practicable to the left-hand edge of the extreme left-hand lane or portion of the ROADWAY lawfully available to traffic moving in the DRIVER's direction.
rules.note: CVC 22100(b). On a two-way road this means near the center line or in the left-turn lane; on a one-way road, near the left curb.

rules.title: Do not start left turn before intersection
rules.when: making a left turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: begin the left turn before entering the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST NOT begin the left turn before entering the INTERSECTION.

rules.title: Leave intersection in a lawful lane
rules.when: making a left turn after entering an INTERSECTION
rules.action: make the turn so as to leave the INTERSECTION in a lane lawfully available to traffic moving in that direction on the ROADWAY being entered
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn after entering an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST make the turn so as to leave the INTERSECTION in a lane lawfully available to traffic moving in that direction on the ROADWAY being entered.
rules.note: CVC 22100(b). The handbook instructs turning into the left lane of the road entered (TURN-LT-04).

rules.title: End left turn in left lane
rules.when: completing a left turn from a single left-turn lane
rules.action: end the turn in the left lane for traffic moving in the DRIVER's direction on the road entered
rules.statement: WHEN completing a left turn from a single left-turn lane, the DRIVER MUST end the turn in the left lane for traffic moving in the DRIVER's direction on the road entered.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Yield to oncoming traffic
rules.when: intending to turn left or complete a U-TURN upon a highway, or to turn left into public or private property or an alley
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching from the opposite direction that are close enough to constitute a hazard at any time during the turning movement, and continue to yield until the turn can be made with reasonable safety
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn left or complete a U-TURN upon a highway, or to turn left into public or private property or an alley, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching from the opposite direction that are close enough to constitute a hazard at any time during the turning movement, and continue to yield until the turn can be made with reasonable safety.

vague_terms.term: close enough to constitute a hazard

rules.title: Keep wheels straight while waiting
rules.when: stopped or waiting to make a left turn
rules.action: keep the front wheels pointed straight ahead until it is safe to start the turn
rules.statement: WHEN stopped or waiting to make a left turn, the DRIVER MUST keep the front wheels pointed straight ahead until it is safe to start the turn.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook; reason given: if hit from behind with wheels turned, the vehicle could be pushed into oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Left turn on red only one-way to one-way
rules.when: facing a steady circular red signal
rules.action: turn left after stopping and after yielding to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION, and only when turning from a ONE-WAY STREET onto a ONE-WAY STREET
rules.statement: WHEN facing a steady circular red signal, the DRIVER MAY ONLY turn left after stopping and after yielding to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION, and only when turning from a ONE-WAY STREET onto a ONE-WAY STREET, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.

rules.title: Left turn across double yellow line
rules.when: turning left into or out of a private road or driveway AND the center of the ROADWAY is marked with a single or double solid yellow line
rules.action: cross the solid yellow line to make the turn
rules.statement: WHEN turning left into or out of a private road or driveway AND the center of the ROADWAY is marked with a single or double solid yellow line, the DRIVER MAY cross the solid yellow line to make the turn.
rules.note: CVC 21460(b) exception; California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: No turn across two sets of double yellow lines
rules.when: two sets of solid double yellow lines spaced two feet or more apart separate the lanes
rules.action: drive over them or make a left turn or U-TURN across them
rules.unless: crossing at an opening or crossover designated for that purpose
rules.statement: WHEN two sets of solid double yellow lines spaced two feet or more apart separate the lanes, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive over them or make a left turn or U-TURN across them, UNLESS crossing at an opening or crossover designated for that purpose.
rules.note: CVC 21651(a); the handbook treats such lines as a solid wall.

rules.title: Multiple turn lanes
rules.when: signs or lane arrows show that turns may be made from more than one lane
rules.action: turn from any lane so marked
rules.statement: WHEN signs or lane arrows show that turns may be made from more than one lane, the DRIVER MAY turn from any lane so marked.
rules.note: CVC 22100(c) and 22101; California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Stay in lane through a multi-lane turn
rules.when: turning from one of two or more marked turn lanes
rules.action: stay in the corresponding lane through the turn and end the turn in that lane
rules.statement: WHEN turning from one of two or more marked turn lanes, the DRIVER MUST stay in the corresponding lane through the turn and end the turn in that lane.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook (shown in turn diagrams); unsafe lane changes in the intersection also violate CVC 21658.

rules.title: Use of two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE is marked
rules.action: drive in the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE when preparing for or making a left turn from or into the highway, or a lawful U-TURN, and for no more than 200 feet while preparing for or making the turn or preparing to merge into the adjacent lanes
rules.statement: WHEN a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE is marked, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive in the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE when preparing for or making a left turn from or into the highway, or a lawful U-TURN, and for no more than 200 feet while preparing for or making the turn or preparing to merge into the adjacent lanes.
rules.note: CVC 21460.5(c). Force is REQUIREMENT; MAY ONLY expresses the restriction.

rules.title: No passing in two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE is marked
rules.action: use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a regular traffic lane
rules.statement: WHEN a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE is marked, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a regular traffic lane.
rules.note: CVC 21460.5; California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Watch for oncoming vehicles in center lane
rules.when: entering or driving in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: look for vehicles coming toward the DRIVER in the same lane and enter the lane only when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN entering or driving in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST look for vehicles coming toward the DRIVER in the same lane and enter the lane only when it is safe.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Turning left out of a side street via center lane
rules.when: turning left from a side street or driveway onto a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE AND the DRIVER has signalled and waited until it is safe
rules.action: drive into the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE and then merge into traffic when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN turning left from a side street or driveway onto a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE AND the DRIVER has signalled and waited until it is safe, the DRIVER MAY drive into the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE and then merge into traffic when it is safe.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook; the 200-foot limit of TURN-LANE-03 still applies.

rules.title: Roundabout lane for right turn
rules.when: approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn right
rules.action: choose the right lane, or follow lane signs and markings
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn right, the DRIVER MUST choose the right lane, or follow lane signs and markings.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook roundabout guidance.

rules.title: Roundabout lane for left turn or U-turn
rules.when: approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn left or make a U-TURN
rules.action: choose the left lane, or follow lane signs and markings
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn left or make a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST choose the left lane, or follow lane signs and markings.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook roundabout guidance.

rules.title: Turning on circular green
rules.when: facing a circular green signal
rules.action: turn right or left after yielding to other traffic and to PEDESTRIANS lawfully within the INTERSECTION or an adjacent CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN facing a circular green signal, the DRIVER MAY turn right or left after yielding to other traffic and to PEDESTRIANS lawfully within the INTERSECTION or an adjacent CROSSWALK, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.
rules.note: CVC 21451(a). Left turns on a circular green also require yielding to oncoming traffic (TURN-LT-05).

rules.title: Turning on green arrow
rules.when: facing a GREEN ARROW
rules.action: cautiously enter the INTERSECTION to make the movement indicated by the arrow after yielding to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully in the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN facing a GREEN ARROW, the DRIVER MAY cautiously enter the INTERSECTION to make the movement indicated by the arrow after yielding to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully in the INTERSECTION.

rules.title: Flashing yellow arrow
rules.when: facing a FLASHING YELLOW ARROW
rules.action: first yield to oncoming traffic and PEDESTRIANS and then make the turn with caution
rules.statement: WHEN facing a FLASHING YELLOW ARROW, the DRIVER MUST first yield to oncoming traffic and PEDESTRIANS and then make the turn with caution.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook; the turn is permitted but not protected.

rules.title: Steady yellow arrow
rules.when: facing a YELLOW ARROW AND the DRIVER cannot stop safely or is already in the INTERSECTION
rules.action: cautiously complete the turn and pay attention to the next signal
rules.statement: WHEN facing a YELLOW ARROW AND the DRIVER cannot stop safely or is already in the INTERSECTION, the DRIVER SHOULD cautiously complete the turn and pay attention to the next signal.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook: the protected turning period is ending; a driver able to stop safely is expected to stop.

rules.title: U-turn on green at intersection
rules.when: at an INTERSECTION facing a green light or GREEN ARROW AND it is safe
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.unless: a No U-Turn sign is posted
rules.statement: WHEN at an INTERSECTION facing a green light or GREEN ARROW AND it is safe, the DRIVER MAY make a U-TURN, UNLESS a No U-Turn sign is posted.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook; CVC 22100.5 limits U-turns at signal-controlled intersections to those permitted by the signal.

rules.title: U-turn across double yellow line
rules.when: it is safe and legal
rules.action: make a U-TURN across a double yellow line
rules.statement: WHEN it is safe and legal, the DRIVER MAY make a U-TURN across a double yellow line.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook; does not apply to two sets of double yellow lines (TURN-LT-09).

rules.title: U-turns in business districts
rules.when: in a BUSINESS DISTRICT
rules.action: make a U-TURN at an INTERSECTION or at an opening provided for turns in a DIVIDED HIGHWAY
rules.statement: WHEN in a BUSINESS DISTRICT, the DRIVER MAY ONLY make a U-TURN at an INTERSECTION or at an opening provided for turns in a DIVIDED HIGHWAY.
rules.note: CVC 22102; any posted No U-Turn sign still applies.

rules.title: U-turns in residence districts
rules.when: in a RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND any vehicle is approaching within 200 feet
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.unless: the U-TURN is made at an INTERSECTION where an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE controls traffic and protects the DRIVER from approaching vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN in a RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND any vehicle is approaching within 200 feet, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN, UNLESS the U-TURN is made at an INTERSECTION where an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE controls traffic and protects the DRIVER from approaching vehicles.

rules.title: No U-turn in front of fire station
rules.when: in front of the driveway entrance or approach to a fire station
rules.action: make a U-TURN or use the fire station driveway to turn around
rules.statement: WHEN in front of the driveway entrance or approach to a fire station, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN or use the fire station driveway to turn around.
rules.note: CVC 22104; California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: No U-turn without 200 feet of view
rules.when: the DRIVER cannot see clearly for 200 feet in each direction because of a curve, hill, rain, fog or other reason
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER cannot see clearly for 200 feet in each direction because of a curve, hill, rain, fog or other reason, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.
rules.note: CVC 22105; California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: No U-turn where sign prohibits
rules.when: a No U-Turn sign is posted
rules.action: make a U-TURN where the sign applies
rules.statement: WHEN a No U-Turn sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN where the sign applies.

rules.title: No U-turn at railroad crossing
rules.when: at or on a railroad crossing
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN at or on a railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.
rules.note: Listed as an illegal U-turn in the California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: U-turn on divided highway only at opening
rules.when: on a DIVIDED HIGHWAY
rules.action: make a U-TURN through an opening provided in the center divider, and not by crossing a dividing section, curb, strip of land or two sets of double yellow lines
rules.statement: WHEN on a DIVIDED HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MAY ONLY make a U-TURN through an opening provided in the center divider, and not by crossing a dividing section, curb, strip of land or two sets of double yellow lines.
rules.note: CVC 21651; California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: No U-turn on one-way street
rules.when: on a ONE-WAY STREET
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN on a ONE-WAY STREET, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.
rules.note: Listed as an illegal U-turn in the California Driver Handbook; also violates CVC 21657 (driving against one-way traffic).

rules.title: No U-turn when other vehicles may hit you
rules.when: other vehicles may hit the DRIVER's vehicle during the turn
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN other vehicles may hit the DRIVER's vehicle during the turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or speed of other vehicles given

rules.note: Listed as an illegal U-turn in the California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: U-turn in residence district when protected
rules.when: in a RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND no vehicles are approaching within 200 feet, OR a traffic sign, light or signal protects the DRIVER from approaching vehicles
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.unless: a No U-Turn sign is posted
rules.statement: WHEN in a RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND no vehicles are approaching within 200 feet, OR a traffic sign, light or signal protects the DRIVER from approaching vehicles, the DRIVER MAY make a U-TURN, UNLESS a No U-Turn sign is posted.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook; CVC 22103. The 200-foot visibility rule (TURN-UT-06) also applies.

rules.title: Yield to pedestrians in crosswalk when turning
rules.when: turning at an INTERSECTION AND a PEDESTRIAN is crossing the ROADWAY within any marked or unmarked CROSSWALK
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to the PEDESTRIAN
rules.statement: WHEN turning at an INTERSECTION AND a PEDESTRIAN is crossing the ROADWAY within any marked or unmarked CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to the PEDESTRIAN.
rules.note: CVC 21950(a); also CVC 21451 and 21453 for signal-controlled turns.

rules.title: Watch between vehicle and curb on right turn
rules.when: making a right turn
rules.action: watch for PEDESTRIANS, CYCLISTS and motorcycles between the vehicle and the curb
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST watch for PEDESTRIANS, CYCLISTS and motorcycles between the vehicle and the curb.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Watch for pedestrians when turning
rules.when: turning at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: look for PEDESTRIANS crossing or about to cross the street being entered
rules.statement: WHEN turning at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST look for PEDESTRIANS crossing or about to cross the street being entered.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Do not squeeze beside a turning truck
rules.when: a large truck or bus ahead is making a wide right turn
rules.action: try to squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb or pass it on the right
rules.statement: WHEN a large truck or bus ahead is making a wide right turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT try to squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb or pass it on the right.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook (sharing the road with large vehicles), which explains that large trucks may swing left or use more than one lane to turn right.
